get.description: Returns the role, its curated topics ordered by display order, the prerequisite edges between them, and the full external roadmap (roadmap.sh) imported into our own database. `external_topics` is empty for a role with no vendored snapshot.

404.description: Role slug was not found or is inactive.
Role slug was not found or is inactive.

Account.description: The identity a signed-in respondent gets back when they ask who they are.

current_question.description: Deprecated: read GET /api/v1/assessment-sessions/{id}/next-question/ instead. Still served, and still the same value.

ExternalRoadmapSource.description: Provenance of the imported third-party graph backing ``external_topics``.

ExternalRoadmapTopic.description:
One topic of the role's external roadmap, served from imported master data.

The list is already ordered so a prerequisite precedes what it unlocks;
``prerequisite_titles`` / ``follow_on_titles`` / ``subtopic_titles`` are the
graph relationships resolved to human-readable titles.

HeldTopicMarkRequest.description: Which Assessable Topic Set the respondent says they can already work on.

LikertResponseScaleChoice.description: One rung of the five-point agreement scale, labeled in the session language.

QuestionTypeEnum.description:
* `yes_no` - Yes / No
* `yes_no_maybe` - Yes / No / Maybe
* `likert_5` - Five-Point Agreement Scale
* `single_choice` - Single Choice
* `ranked_choice` - Ranked Choice

Registration.description: The email and password pair a respondent presents to register or to sign in.

RoadmapPrerequisiteEdge.description:
One prerequisite edge of a role's roadmap graph.

``prerequisite`` may point at a topic owned by another role, so a client
rendering the graph should tolerate an edge whose endpoint is not in the
``topics`` list.

RoleRoadmap.description: A role's full roadmap: the role, its active topics in prerequisite order, and the edges between them.

SignIn.description: The email and password pair a respondent presents to register or to sign in.
